text:
Kevin Ortiz: Quick sync on EdgeWave reseller pilot — they want a joint POC (shared ops + co-sell), answers on pricing uplift, SSO/Security questionnaire, and a simple runbook for entitlements. Partner asked for a response by EOD Friday. Can we map owners and confirm a recommended topology?

Raj Patel: I can take pricing. They asked for a 20% reseller pilot discount and a consumption credit for first month. Need to confirm if we do pass-through billing or co-bill via EdgeWave — @Legal + @Finance will need to weigh in.

Maria Chen: I can own the POC arch. Two options to propose:
- Shared tenant (faster): single hosted tenant + per-customer API keys, lower ops but higher isolation risk.
- Dedicated logical tenant (recommended for enterprise pilots): separate project/namespace, token isolation, dedicated routing to EdgeWave for SLA.
We should do SAML SSO + optional VPC peering for data-sensitive flows. Example SAML stub for partner:
```
EntityID: https://edgewave.example/saml/metadata
ACS: https://edgewave.example/saml/acs
Cert: -----BEGIN CERT-----
<partner-SP-cert>
-----END CERT-----
```
Will also collect partner contact for cert exchange and tenant name.

Sylvia Park: For PartnerEng notes: Dedicated logical tenant can be placed on a Dedicated pool with resource isolation and quotas. Need the partner SP metadata + their IP ranges for our egress allowlist. Network rules: outbound to partner endpoints on 443; inbound only from our management plane (no direct SSH). Also we’ll add a short runbook entry for rotating API keys and token TTLs.

Alex Gomez: Capacity/ops: If pilot traffic estimate is modest (1–5 rps, bursty), we can use a 1x reserved GPU cluster and enable burst autoscaling. If they expect low-latency <100ms requirements, we should recommend a quantized model profile and place them on the lower-latency tier. Example routing policy snippet we can apply:
```json
{"route":"edgewave-prod","model":"redwood-llm-q4","fallback":"redwood-llm-q8","quota":{"qps":50}}
```
I'll pre-seed a pool we can flip during the pilot start.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire submitted by EdgeWave: https://internal.docs/sec-forms/edgewave-2026. Checklist flags: data residency requirement (they want EU data stay in eu-west-1), SOC2 scoping question, and SAML audit logs needed. Please attach answers to the doc; DRI for security questions is @Maria Chen for the POC and @Sylvia Park for infra controls.

Maria Chen: Action items: 1) Collect EdgeWave SP metadata + IP ranges (Owner: EdgeWave/partner contact) — due Thurs EOD. 2) Maria: write SAML + runbook draft (due Thurs 12pm). 3) Sylvia: draft Dedicated pool config & egress rules (due Thurs 3pm). 4) Raj: confirm pricing approach with Legal/Finance (due Thurs EOD). 5) Alex: provision reserved pool and routing policy (done by Fri morning). I'll assemble a one-page POC runbook to send to the partner after we have SP metadata.

Kevin Ortiz: Thanks team. Can we schedule a 30-min partner-facing tech readout Friday 10am PT? If that works I'll invite EdgeWave and include a short demo of the routing/fallback behavior. @Raj Patel can you confirm pricing standby for that meeting.

Raj Patel: Confirmed for me — will have pricing options and pass-through vs co-bill notes ready. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: I'll have the SAML runbook and a short diagram for the Friday session.

Sylvia Park: On it — will share infra config snippet in the doc by EOD Thu.

Alex Gomez: Pool pre-provision scheduled — will send the cluster id in the doc once ready.

Kevin Ortiz: Great. I'll follow up with a calendar invite and add Legal/Product-SSO to the attendees. EdgeWave contact is Maya Singh (maya@edgewave.io).

Raj Patel: noted — looping Maya in the invite will help speed cert exchange.

Kevin Ortiz: Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping this thread. :rocket:
